name: Ayodeji “Ayo” Akintilo
intro: I help teams turn complex products into clear stories and design systems they can use.
about:
I work across brand systems, web experiences, and technical storytelling. At AppOmni, that means connecting reusable page components with the way product marketing, content, and development work together. Through Forge HQ, I partner with teams on campaign systems and presentations.

I like learning from the people closest to the problem, then turning that insight into something clear and useful. My work spans security, developer platforms, enterprise software, and healthcare.
headline:
Brand systems.
Clearer stories.
